import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(21.2, 15.5)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(13.95)
    .workplane(offset=7.7)
    .circle(1.5)
    .loft(combine=True)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(6.7)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0.0))
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10.85), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 90, 0))
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 32.8, 0))
            .ellipse(2.41, 7.6)
            .workplane(offset=55.6)
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, -14.8, 0))
            .ellipse(1.29, 3.65)
            .loft(combine=True)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 180.0))
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 10.85), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 90, 0))
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 32.8, 0))
            .ellipse(2.41, 7.6)
            .workplane(offset=55.6)
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, -14.8, 0))
            .ellipse(1.29, 3.65)
            .loft(combine=True)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .workplane(offset=18.3)
            .circle(8.0)
            .extrude(3.0)
    )
)
show_object(result)
